Let us consider two Markov kernels (mu(s))_s in R^+, (widetildemu(s))_s in R^+ with source R^+ and target R^T and a measure nu on R^+ (T finite set). Defining the probability measures on R^T such that, forall\,\,\,\, B in borelR^T, mu(B) coloneqq int_R^+ mu(s)(B) dnu(s), widetildemu(B) coloneqq int_R^+ widetildemu(s)(B) dnu(s), the following convexity property for the distance W_1 holds: wass[1]muwidetildemu leq int_R^+ wass[1]mu(s)widetildemu(s) dnu(s).
